evidence.key_observation: On one unmodified uart top driven only through its ports, two real serial frames 0x5a and 0xc3 were received and each read back over the AHB port as itself, after which STATUS reported rxempty=1. Writing FIFO_CTRL.RXRST -- the control the register description gives software to clear the receive FIFO -- and then reading RDATA returned 0x5a, the first byte of the session, while STATUS still reported rxempty=1. The residue survived a repeated read and survived pulling rst_ni low. A third byte 0x96 sent afterwards was returned by RDATA, so the location tracks the serial line and the earlier value was not a constant. Leaving OutputZeroIfEmpty at its library default in a scratch copy makes the same bench report checks=7 fails=0 witness_hits=0.
evidence.structural_audit: 31 of 31 gates hold (proof/logs/run.log). src/uart/rtl/uart_core.sv:274 instantiates the receive FIFO as caliptra_prim_fifo_sync #(8, 1'b0, 32, 1'b0); the fourth positional argument is OutputZeroIfEmpty, whose library default is 1'b1 and which the library documents as controlling whether the output is zeroed when the FIFO is empty (src/caliptra_prim/rtl/caliptra_prim_fifo_sync.sv:13).
evidence.idiom_census: The FIFO is instantiated 36 times in the tree outside its own definition (measured 36), so its usage idiom is well established. Exactly one of those instantiations passes parameters positionally (measured 1), and that is the audited line. The transmit FIFO 100 lines above it in the same module passes its parameters by name and does not override OutputZeroIfEmpty, so it takes the documented default; the extracted parameter list is confirmed to be the sibling's rather than empty text, so that gate cannot pass vacuously.
evidence.why_this_instance_differs: 15 instances do set the parameter to zero by name (measured 15), so the value alone is not the finding. What distinguishes the audited one is where its output goes: rdata_o leaves the FIFO on uart_rdata (uart_core.sv:285), which is assigned straight to hw2reg.rdata.d (:133), a field of a register with a published software offset (uart_reg_pkg.sv:333). The others feed internal datapaths.
evidence.ungated_readback: The register block returns the field's value on readback with no empty-condition qualifier (uart_reg_top.sv:1739), the read strobe is qualified only by address and bus validity (:1632), and the field is an external subreg fed straight from the hardware input (:1178-1190).
evidence.contradictory_report_to_software: The same module tells software the FIFO is empty from the FIFO's own valid signal, hw2reg.status.rxempty.d = ~rx_fifo_rvalid (uart_core.sv:135). RXEMPTY is a documented field (src/uart/data/uart.hjson) of a register with a published offset (uart_reg_pkg.sv:332), so a single agent reads both facts and they disagree.
evidence.neither_clear_removes_the_data: resetOnClear defaults to 0 in the library and the audited instance does not enable it, so clr_i does not wipe storage even though it is wired to the software-writable FIFO reset (uart_core.sv:277) and RXRST is a documented software control. The storage array is the no-reset variant (caliptra_prim_fifo_sync.sv:147-152): a bare always_ff @(posedge clk_i) whose sensitivity list and body contain no reset, so a block reset does not clear received payload either. All three facts are gated.
evidence.directed_simulation: checks=7 fails=3 witness_hits=1, all five covers hit (proof/logs/sim.log). Controls: a real serial byte is received and reads back as itself; a second, different byte reads back as itself, which is the anti-vacuity control without which a bench returning a constant would satisfy the residual check for the wrong reason; STATUS reports the FIFO empty after the drain; and after the reset a third byte displaces the residue, establishing that the location read is real storage tracking the serial line. Violating: RDATA after the documented RXRST returns a byte received earlier; the residue persists across a repeated empty read; and it survives rst_ni.
evidence.mechanism: With Pass=1'b0 the FIFO output is storage[fifo_rptr] unconditionally (caliptra_prim_fifo_sync.sv:135, :163, :170). After the drain, fifo_rptr has advanced past both consumed bytes to a location never written, so a read there is indeterminate rather than payload. RXRST resets the pointer to 0, aligning the ungated output onto storage[0] -- a byte software already received. The documented clear is therefore what makes the stale payload deterministic and readable, not what contains it.
evidence.negative_control: 16 of 16 gates hold (proof/logs/negative_control.log). A scratch copy rewrites only the audited instantiation into named parameters with OutputZeroIfEmpty left at the library default, matching the transmit FIFO's form, gated by difflib at exactly 1 line removed and 5 added, with the audited source verified to still contain the defect afterwards. The identical bench then reports checks=7 fails=0 witness_hits=0 and result=NOT_THE_AUDITED_SIGNATURE, while the controls still show both bytes arriving and reading back, so reception was not broken by the change. Transcripts are in proof/negative_control_run/, outside proof/logs/, because a run on corrected RTL legitimately ends in a non-pass verdict.
evidence.reach: The block presents an AHB-Lite slave port, so its registers are reachable by any master on the bus it is attached to, and it ships a register description that marks read-only registers, i.e. it defines a software-visible contract. The instantiation census is reported with a control requiring the pattern to find at least one instance, so a zero would be a real absence rather than a regex miss.

security_impact: Bytes that crossed the UART serial line remain readable through the RDATA register after software has consumed them, while the same block reports through STATUS.RXEMPTY that there is nothing to read. An agent that can read these registers but was not present for the traffic recovers a byte of it. What raises this above a transient artifact is that nothing available to software removes the residue: draining does not, FIFO_CTRL.RXRST -- the control the register description provides precisely for clearing the receive FIFO -- does not, and neither does a block reset, because the FIFO's storage flops carry no reset at all. RXRST in fact makes matters worse rather than better: by returning the read pointer to zero it aligns the ungated output onto the first byte of the session, converting an indeterminate read into a deterministic disclosure of real payload. The exposure is one byte per storage location and is displaced only by new traffic arriving at the same location.
non_findings: Not a claim that OutputZeroIfEmpty = 1'b0 is wrong in general. 15 other instances in the tree set it deliberately and their outputs feed internal datapaths; the finding is that this is the one whose output reaches a software-readable register.
Not a claim that the whole FIFO contents can be walked. The proof establishes one deterministic byte, the one at the location the read pointer lands on after the documented reset.
Not a claim about what the UART console carries in a deployment, so the sensitivity of the leaked byte is not asserted -- only that it is received payload software already consumed.
Not a fault-injection or debug finding. No glitch, no physical access and no debug state is involved; the sequence is three ordinary register accesses.
No integrity or availability claim. There is no write path here and no state is corrupted.

Not a claim that the register block is at fault rather than the instantiation. The readback being ungated is what makes the parameter choice observable, but the negative control shows the parameter alone removes the behaviour.
proof_integrity: One unmodified uart top, driven only through its ports: real 8N1 serial frames into cio_rx_i and all observation over the AHB-Lite slave port. No hierarchical reference into the DUT, no force, no assertion inside the DUT relied upon for any verdict.

Check polarity is fixed by convention: every check states the behaviour the design is supposed to have, so a failing check is the defect speaking. The pass gate demands checks=7, fails=3 and witness_hits=1 together with all five covers, so a bench that silently stopped exercising something cannot report a pass.
A corrected parameter produces a distinct verdict, result=NOT_THE_AUDITED_SIGNATURE, rather than a pass or a failure, so the two outcomes cannot be confused.

Four of the seven checks are controls, and they are load-bearing: two distinct bytes must arrive over the serial line and read back as themselves, STATUS must report empty, and a third distinct byte must displace the residue. Without the last one, 'RDATA returns 0x5a' could be a fixed value the bench would see regardless of what the serial line carried.

Bus stimulus is driven on the negedge and responses are sampled during the cycle in which dv is asserted, because hrdata_o is combinational from dv and the FIFO read pointer advances on the posedge ending that cycle. Sampling a cycle later returns the next location, which would have turned real payload into an indeterminate value and hidden the finding.

Censuses are computed and are written so as not to name the audited signal, so a pattern that failed to match reports a wrong count and fails a gate instead of passing silently. The sibling parameter-list extraction and the instantiation census each carry a control gate requiring the pattern to match something.
The negative-control patch is size-gated with difflib at exactly 1 line removed and 5 added, and re-verifies that the audited source still contains the defect afterwards.
The scratch copy is written under proof/scratch and the negative control's build tree is removed before packaging; nothing in the audited tree is modified by any script.

One assertion inside the DUT's own submodules, AssertConnected_A in caliptra_prim_onehot_check, fires in a compile that does not bind the count-error alert above the block, which is an artifact of the compile rather than a result. The sim script asks VCS to filter it and VCS may report it anyway; it is inert either way, firing identically in the audited and negative-control runs, and the verdict is computed only from the bench's own check counters and covers.
residual_uncertainty: Which agents can reach this block's AHB port is not settled here, so the privilege required is stated from the register interface rather than from an integration. The severity assumes the residue is one byte of prior console traffic; whether that traffic is sensitive depends on what the console carries in a given deployment, which this tree does not determine. Reading further storage locations was not attempted, so the finding is one deterministic byte rather than a bound on how much is recoverable.
